basis: coupled d-q electrical and mechanical response
six simultaneous parameter estimates across disparate physical scales
multiple hidden plants and excitation spectra

candidate_input_boundary.pack_source: A current reference evaluation produces an evaluator-owned per-scenario pack containing only duration and the two public Timeseries; hidden scenario metadata remains outside candidate-readable storage.
candidate_input_boundary.candidate_visibility: Only one sanitized scalar experiment struct is assigned to the base workspace for each run. Hidden scenario metadata and plant truth remain evaluator-local.

counterfactual.name: held_measurement_response
counterfactual.intervention: Keep voltage_command_dq_V unchanged while replacing every measured_electrical_state sample by its first sample; do not save the candidate model.
counterfactual.purpose: A near-truth, replayed, or hard-coded estimate trajectory that is not causally driven by measured response receives C=0.

score_policy.zero_rule: any applicable group at zero makes total zero

Q.meaning: finite complete logs with the published channel contract

M.meaning: active estimator dynamics, signed coupling, and connected diagnostics

C.meaning: measurement causality, cross-plant response, and anti-copy behavior
